reviewed_by: Codex visual inspection of saved rendered images and original source figures
findings: Isometric and plan show two distinct shafts, paired outward mounting feet and eight bolt/nut/lock sets on the sloping floors. No unsupported floating floor pads.

Port section shows continuous plate feet contacting floor material and complete bolt projection beyond nuts. Main front boss cantilevers forward of the foot; this is an estimated profile, not a source tracing.

Fixed SNL6 plan registration puts shaft spans/axes and side-plate planes near the corresponding source outlines. These shaft pixels are construction anchors, not holdouts; no independent millimetric source validation is claimed.

Plate floor flanges project outboard of the drawing side-plate lines; their width/profile and attachment to this particular sloped hull are hypotheses. Complete seat support extensions/attachments are still absent.

M782/source38.0238mm diameter makes its shaft visibly larger than M783 estimated25.4mm. The actual source-sized cotters now clear all saved hardware; M782 outboard retention remains a separate historical uncertainty.
limits: The drawing contains broken long rods; no whole-layout calibration or pose comparison.
No complete driver mechanism, seat attachment, spring anchors or motion qualification.
Absolute driver station remains provisional until actual low-link receivers close source-length M574 rods.
